name: MonarchMentionPicker
title: MentionPicker
wrapsNative: A full-width VStack of Buttons (MonarchAvatar and Text) in a ScrollView when long, placed with safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) above the composer and the keyboard; redacted(reason: .placeholder) while loading; MonarchInlineErrorRetry on failure; .task(id:) runs the product's search
summary: Suggestions for an @mention or #channel: a strip of people and channels above the keyboard, with loading, empty and error states, and helpers that find the mention being typed and replace it.
whenToUse: In a message or comment composer where people mention others with @ or channels with #.
whenNotToUse: Not for general search suggestions; use searchable(text:) with searchSuggestions. Not for choosing people in a form; use a Picker or a List with a selection.
api: init(_ query: MonarchMentionQuery?, items: [MonarchMentionItem], status: MonarchMentionPickerStatus = .ready, labels: MonarchMentionPickerLabels = MonarchMentionPickerLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: @escaping @MainActor (MonarchMentionItem) -> Void)
static func MonarchMentionQuery.find(in text: String, caret: String.Index? = nil, triggers: Set<Character> = ["@"]) -> MonarchMentionQuery?
func MonarchMentionQuery.replacing(in text: String, with replacement: String) -> String
MonarchMentionQuery.init(trigger: Character, text: String, range: Range<String.Index>)
MonarchMentionItem.init(id: String, label: String, kind: MonarchMentionKind = .person, detail: String? = nil, avatarURL: URL? = nil, isDisabled: Bool = false)
enum MonarchMentionPickerStatus { case loading, ready, failed }

MonarchMentionPickerLabels.init(label: String? = nil, people: String? = nil, channels: String? = nil, loading: String? = nil, empty: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, retry: String? = nil, count: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil)

options.name: query
options.description: The mention being typed, from MonarchMentionQuery.find. Nothing is drawn while it is nil.

options.name: items
options.description: The suggestions from the product's search, people and channels.

options.name: status
options.description: loading shows placeholder rows, failed shows the error, ready shows the items or "No matches".

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the list's name, the group headings, the state texts, the retry button and the count announcement.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Repeats a failed search; adds a retry button to the error.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Receives the chosen suggestion. Replace the query with query.replacing(in:with:) and close the query.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three placeholder rows, redacted, read as "Searching…".

states.name: results
states.description: A row per suggestion; people and channels under headings when both are present; more than four scroll.

states.name: disabled suggestion
states.description: Text in the disabled colour; the row cannot be chosen.

states.name: no matches
states.description: "No matches". After a query with a space finds nothing, the picker closes.

states.name: failed
states.description: "Couldn’t load suggestions." with a retry button when onRetry is given.

appearance: A strip on the surface colour with a subtle top border; labels in the default text colour, details and headings in the muted text colour, disabled rows in the disabled text colour; avatars with their fallback colours and a square number-sign tile for channels. The same roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web anchors a listbox to the caret with aria-activedescendant and arrow keys, and ships hooks that debounce and abort the search. SwiftUI gives no caret rectangle, so iOS shows a full-width strip above the composer in the bottom safe-area inset, and suggestions are buttons. The product runs its search in .task(id: query), which cancels the previous one; Monarch adds no debounce timer. MonarchMentionQuery.find assumes the caret is at the end unless a caret index is passed, because TextField does not expose its selection on iOS 17. The token format of MonarchMentionItem.token matches the web's formatMentionToken; the web's parseMentionTokens has no iOS counterpart in this release.
accessibility: Each suggestion is a button whose label is its name and detail; a disabled suggestion is dimmed and not activatable.
The list is a container named "Suggestions"; group headings have the header trait.
The result count, "Searching…", "No matches" and the error are announced as the state changes, so focus can stay in the text field.
Avatars and the channel tile are hidden from VoiceOver.
Rows are at least 44 points high and grow with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: A trigger inside a word, such as an email address, does not open the picker.
A query ends after two words, a line break or a word longer than 40 characters.
Replacing a query removes one space after it, so a mention typed mid-sentence does not leave two spaces.
A query's range belongs to the text it was found in; find it again after the text changes.
